items.title: From Backtest Profit to Deployable Evidence: Cost sensitivity, statistical uncertainty, and implementation risk in proprietary systematic trading
items.claim: Doubling trading costs leaves Strategy B with 1.75 normalized units versus 76.90 for Strategy A conditional on the selected records.

items.title: An Algebraic Accounting DSL as a Harness for LLM Agents: An Evaluation with Exchange Algebra
items.claim: gpt-oss:120b answered 0.189 of tasks wrongly under the exchange algebra harness versus 0.711 with Python.

items.title: Ill AI Warn a Nigerian? How Language Models Respond to Regulator Flagged Investment Schemes in Nigeria and the United Kingdom
items.claim: No UK-flagged investment scheme received a knowledge-based warning from either language model in the pilot study.

items.title: Detecting Order Flow Toxicity in Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures: A LightGBM Approach Using L2 Microstructure Features
items.claim: Filtering trades with predicted toxicity above 0.6 removed 12.9% of trades and reduced the toxicity rate from 13.08% to 10.48%.

items.title: How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
items.claim: Under a growth priority OpenAI reports favored Microsoft while Anthropic reports favored Alphabet despite identical prompts.

items.title: Which Past Matters? Training History and Multi-Forecast Horizon in Equity Transformers
items.claim: An equal-weight ensemble of twelve models exceeded every individual mean at 15 20 and 25 minutes but not elsewhere.
